war_summary: War 139 is on day 131 of conquest with 32 victory towns required and no winner declared. Colonials fully control AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, DrownedValeHex, and others, while Wardens hold BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, StlicanShelfHex, and ViperPitHex. The heaviest fighting and strategic-base volatility is concentrated in EndlessShoreHex, ClahstraHex, CallahansPassageHex, OnyxHex, OarbreakerHex, and SpeakingWoodsHex, where casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating and bases are actively flipping or going neutral. MarbanHollow, MooringCountyHex, GodcroftsHex, and StemaLandingHex also show recent ownership events but at somewhat lower intensity, while large swaths of the map remain stable with minimal activity, indicating that the next 24 hours of strategic-base changes will likely be localized to these high-activity contested corridors.
